text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ngaah!! And here I thought I had that in 
the bag~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that what you're thinking!? It's 
okay! Lady Luck is on my side!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"After all, today's race time had my lucky 
number in it~!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Which means next time we'll win...! No, 
it's practically already our victory!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu! Yes, indeed! After all, I am one 
lucky Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Consider yourself on a treasure ship, and 
leave it all to me with a grand boom~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Bobbing along~♪ Rolling in treasure, 
bobbing along~♪"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha~! I totally get it, okay~? I'll do 
it properly, I really will!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
As you can see, I'm a very reliable girl! 
Being dependable is my specialty among 
specialties!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh!? Now that I look closer, my 
left horseshoe is gone!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Awawa... One of my lucky items is...!! 
Wh-Where is it~~?!

Knowing the road ahead would be tough... I 
resolved to work even harder to make sure 
the result would be a great blessing.
